story-aesop-town-mouse: Two small brown mice in a grand candlelit dining-room of long ago, perched on a long table among the remains of a feast: jellies, cakes, a silver dish and a tipped goblet. One mouse is sleek and smartly groomed, the other is rough-coated and wide-eyed. A tall carved door stands just ajar in the warm shadows. Painted in the soft watercolour and ink of a classic Victorian picture-book.
story-aesop-lion-mouse: A great golden lion lies tied with thick ropes to the trunk of a tree at the edge of a sunny grassland, looking tired and sad. A tiny grey mouse sits on the rope by his shoulder, nibbling at it busily. Tall grass, a few distant trees and a wide pale sky. A gentle, warm classic picture-book illustration in watercolour and ink.
story-grimm-elves: A small, cosy shoemaker's workshop of old Germany at early morning: a wooden workbench under a leaded window, pieces of cut leather, a last and little hammers, and in the middle of the bench one perfect pair of new leather shoes. An honest-looking old shoemaker in an apron and his wife in a shawl peer at the shoes in wonder. Warm candle and dawn light, painted like a classic fairy-tale book illustration.
story-grimm-elves-2: The same snug workshop on a winter night near Christmas: a fire glowing in the hearth, a candle left burning on the workbench beside cut leather, and an old shoemaker and his wife peeping out from behind a curtain hung in the corner. Snow on the window panes. A classic fairy-tale book illustration in warm watercolour.
story-andersen-real-princess: An impossibly tall bed in a palace bedroom of a fairy-tale kingdom, piled with twenty patterned mattresses and twenty plump feather beds, reaching almost to the painted ceiling. A young woman in a nightgown peeps over the very top, looking uncomfortable, while a ladder leans against the stack. Candlelight and a stormy window. Painted in the style of a classic Danish fairy-tale book illustration.
story-andersen-real-princess-2: A rain-soaked young woman with dripping hair stands at the open door of a palace on a stormy night, lit by a lantern held by an old king in a dressing-gown and crown. Lightning over dark hills behind her. A classic fairy-tale book illustration in watercolour and ink.
story-justso-elephant: A young grey elephant with a short, bulgy nose like a boot stands looking up with eager curiosity at a tall ostrich and a spotted giraffe, under the hot sun of an African plain. Thorn-trees and dry grass around them. Drawn in the bold, playful line and soft colour of an early twentieth-century children's book illustration.
story-justso-elephant-2: A young elephant with a short nose stands beside a thorny bush where a small, bright bird sits calling out. Far away a broad grey-green river winds between pale fever-trees. Warm afternoon light, in the playful style of an early twentieth-century children's book illustration.
story-stevenson-shadow: A small Victorian child in a nightshirt jumps towards a little bed at lamplight, and a long dark shadow leaps on the bedroom wall ahead of the child. A rag doll on the floor and a candle on a stool. A gentle, classic children's poetry book illustration in pen and watercolour.
story-stevenson-swing: A child of long ago in a pinafore swings high on a rope swing hung from an old tree, flying up above a garden wall. Beyond the wall a river, trees and grazing cattle stretch across green countryside under a clear blue sky, and below lies a cottage with a brown roof. A sunny classic children's poetry book illustration in watercolour.
story-blake-lamb: A small child of long ago in a simple smock kneels in a green meadow beside a stream, gently reaching out to a soft white lamb. Gentle hills and a pale golden sky behind them, with a few sheep grazing in the distance. Painted in the delicate, glowing watercolour of an illuminated poetry book of the 1780s, with curling vines at the edges and no words.
story-lear-limericks: A cheerful old man with an enormous bushy beard sits on a stool while two owls, a hen, four larks and a wren build nests in his beard. Drawn in the loose, funny pen-and-ink line of a Victorian book of nonsense, lightly washed with colour, on a plain pale background.
story-aesop-hare-tortoise: A sunny country lane winding between fields: a long-eared brown hare lies fast asleep under a shady tree at the roadside, while a small, determined tortoise plods steadily past towards a wooden post at the far end. Other animals watch from the hedge. A warm classic Victorian fable-book illustration in watercolour and ink.
story-peterrabbit-garden: A small young rabbit in a little blue jacket with brass buttons nibbles a radish in a neat English vegetable garden of about 1900, among rows of lettuces and French beans. A cucumber frame and a wooden gate stand in the background. Soft, delicate watercolour in the gentle style of an Edwardian nature picture-book.
story-peterrabbit-garden-2: In the same English vegetable garden, a small rabbit in a blue jacket is tangled by his buttons in a gooseberry net, while three little sparrows flutter round him. A gardener's rake leans by the cabbages. Soft, delicate Edwardian picture-book watercolour.
story-tagore-champa: A courtyard of a Bengali village house a century ago, shaded by a tall champa tree covered in creamy yellow flowers. A mother in a plain sari with long wet hair walks through the dappled shade carrying a brass pot, and one flower high on a branch seems to be smiling down at her. Soft, glowing colours in the manner of an early twentieth-century Indian wash painting.
story-tagore-champa-2: Evening in the same Bengali village: a mother in a sari carries a small lighted oil lamp towards a thatched cow-shed, and a little child runs to her out of the dusk beneath the champa tree. Warm lamplight against a deep blue sky, in the soft manner of an early twentieth-century Indian wash painting.
story-stevenson-counterpane: A child of long ago sits propped on two big pillows in bed, and across the rumpled patchwork bedspread march rows of tiny toy soldiers over folds like hills, while little toy ships sail among the sheets and wooden toy houses stand in a town. A gentle, cosy classic children's poetry book illustration in pen and watercolour.
story-jungle-mowgli: Moonlit night at the mouth of a wolves' cave in an Indian jungle: a big grey father wolf stands astonished before a tiny laughing baby who holds on to a low branch. Ferns, tangled creepers and tall trees all around, with eyes of cubs shining from the cave. A classic Edwardian jungle-book illustration in deep greens and silver.
story-jungle-mowgli-2: Inside a warm, earthy wolves' cave, a gentle grey mother wolf curls around her four cubs, and a small baby is snuggled in among them, quite unafraid. Moonlight falls across the entrance. A classic Edwardian jungle-book illustration.
story-jungle-rikki: A small bedraggled mongoose lies on a sunny garden path after a summer flood, beside a wide bungalow with a deep veranda in India about 1890. A small boy in a sailor suit and his mother bend over it with worried faces. Palms, puddles and bright flowers. A classic illustration in the style of a Victorian jungle storybook.
story-jungle-rikki-2: A lively mongoose with a fluffed-up tail sits on the shoulder of a laughing small boy in a sailor suit, tickling his chin, at a table with a lump of cotton wool, inside a cool bungalow room of about 1890. A classic Victorian storybook illustration.
story-alice-rabbit-hole: A sunny Victorian riverbank: a girl with long fair hair in a pinafore dress sits up in surprise beside her older sister, who is reading. A white rabbit with pink eyes, wearing a waistcoat, hurries past holding a pocket-watch, towards a large rabbit-hole under a hedge. A classic Victorian book illustration in fine pen and soft colour.
story-alice-rabbit-hole-2: A girl in a pinafore dress floats slowly down a deep, dim, round shaft lined with cupboards and bookshelves, her hair and skirts drifting upwards in a dreamlike fall. A classic Victorian book illustration in fine pen and soft colour.
story-alice-cheshire: A girl with long fair hair in a pinafore dress stands at a fork in a wood, looking up at a large striped cat with an enormous wide grin, lounging on the branch of a tree. One path leads off each way among the trees. A classic Victorian book illustration in fine pen and soft colour.
story-alice-cheshire-2: The same striped cat on its branch, waving one paw this way and the other paw that way, while the girl in the pinafore listens with her hands behind her back. A classic Victorian book illustration in fine pen and soft colour.
story-wind-boats: A sunny English river in early summer: a brown water rat in a little blue-and-white rowing boat holds up a paw to help a shy, velvety mole step down from the grassy bank. Willows, reeds and gentle ripples. A classic Edwardian riverbank illustration in soft watercolour.
story-wind-boats-2: A small blue-and-white rowing boat has bumped into a grassy riverbank: a water rat lies on his back in the bottom of the boat with his feet in the air, and a mole clutches the side in surprise. Willows and sunlight. A classic Edwardian riverbank illustration in soft watercolour.
story-secretgarden-door: A thin girl of about ten in a dark Edwardian coat and hat pulls aside a curtain of thick ivy on a high old garden wall, finding a round iron door-knob beneath it, while a red-breasted robin sings on a branch beside her. Early spring light on the long walk of an old moorland manor. A classic Edwardian children's book illustration in soft watercolour.
story-secretgarden-door-2: The girl in the dark coat stands just inside a small wooden door in the wall, her back against it, gazing at a wild, sleeping walled garden full of grey rose-branches, old trees and the first green shoots of spring. A classic Edwardian children's book illustration in soft watercolour.
story-peterpan-flying: An Edwardian town-house nursery at night, lit by a soft lamp: three children in long nightclothes float up near the ceiling above their beds, laughing and kicking a little, while a boy dressed in leaves hovers gracefully beside them and a tiny glowing fairy light darts by the window. A classic Edwardian children's book illustration in soft watercolour.
story-heidi-fire: A high Alpine meadow at sunset: a little girl with short dark curls springs to her feet among blue bell-shaped flowers, pointing in wonder at snowy peaks and rocks glowing red and rose-pink, while a quiet goatherd boy sits whittling a stick beside his goats. Fir trees below. A classic nineteenth-century Swiss storybook illustration in glowing watercolour.
story-heidi-fire-2: The same Alpine meadow in the cool grey dusk after sunset: the mountain peaks have faded to grey, and a little girl and a goatherd boy walk down the path with a small flock of goats. A first star in the sky. A classic nineteenth-century storybook illustration in soft watercolour.
story-blackbeauty-advice: A large, pleasant English meadow of the 1870s with a clear pond, water-lilies and shady trees leaning over it: a young black foal with a white star on his forehead stands close beside his gentle dark mother, who bends her head to him. In the background other colts gallop in a group. A classic Victorian animal-story illustration in soft oil-paint colours.
story-blackbeauty-advice-2: The same meadow at evening: a young black foal and his mother stand together by the gate, while a farmhouse by the roadside glows with lamplight beyond the hedge. A peaceful classic Victorian animal-story illustration.
story-andersen-emperor: A grand procession through the streets of an old European city: a proud, round emperor in his crown and long underclothes strides beneath a tall canopy, while courtiers pretend to carry an invisible train and crowds at windows applaud. A small child at the front points and laughs. A classic fairy-tale book illustration in watercolour and ink, gentle and funny.
story-tomsawyer-fence: A sunny street in a small American river town of the 1840s: a barefoot boy in a straw hat brushes white paint on a long wooden board fence with great care, while another boy holding a half-eaten apple watches, fascinated. A bucket of whitewash at their feet and leafy trees above. A classic nineteenth-century American storybook illustration.
story-tomsawyer-fence-2: The same sunny street: one barefoot boy sits on a barrel in the shade, legs dangling, munching an apple, while another boy eagerly whitewashes the long board fence. A classic nineteenth-century American storybook illustration.
story-velveteen-real: A quiet nursery of the 1920s by a warm fireplace with a brass fender: a soft brown-and-white velveteen toy rabbit with pink sateen ears lies beside a very old toy horse whose brown coat is worn bald in patches. A few wind-up toys lie about on the rug. Gentle, tender colours, like a classic 1920s picture-book illustration.
story-velveteen-real-2: The old worn toy horse and the velveteen rabbit side by side on the nursery rug in the firelight, the horse smiling kindly, the rabbit gazing up at him. A tender classic 1920s picture-book illustration.
story-littlewomen-presents: A modest American parlour on a winter evening in the 1860s: four sisters of different ages in plain dresses gather by the fire, one lying on the rug, one in an old dress gazing down, the youngest with fair curls, and a quiet one knitting in the corner. Lamplight, a worn carpet and snow at the window. A classic nineteenth-century American storybook illustration.
story-anne-matthew: A small country railway platform by green farmland in spring, about 1900: a thin girl of eleven with two long red braids, freckles and a faded sailor hat sits on a pile of shingles clutching a shabby carpet-bag, and stands to hold out her hand to a shy, stooping elderly farmer with a grey beard. Cherry trees in white bloom beyond. A classic Edwardian storybook illustration in soft watercolour.
story-treasure-benbow: A lonely old inn on a cliff above a grey cove in eighteenth-century England: a tall, weather-beaten sailor with a tarry pigtail, a blue coat and a scar on his cheek stands at the inn door, a sea-chest behind him on a hand-barrow, while a boy watches from the doorway. Gulls and a cold sea. A classic adventure-book illustration in muted oils, without any sign or lettering on the inn.
story-wordsworth-daffodils: A wide lakeshore beneath trees in spring, with thousands of golden daffodils dancing in the breeze along the water's edge and sparkling little waves beyond. A solitary figure in a long coat of about 1800 stands on the path, gazing at them. Soft romantic landscape painting in watercolour.
story-dickinson-hope: A small brown songbird perches singing on a slender branch in a strong wind, its feathers ruffled but its song bright, against a stormy grey sky with a warm gleam of light breaking through. Delicate nineteenth-century botanical-style watercolour.
story-lookingglass-humpty: A huge egg with a solemn face, a cravat and little legs sits cross-legged on top of a very high, very narrow wall, gazing away grandly, while a girl with long fair hair in a pinafore dress stands below with her hands held out, ready to catch him. Trees and a chessboard-like countryside behind. A classic Victorian book illustration in fine pen and soft colour.
story-oz-cyclone: A small grey wooden farmhouse alone on the flat, grey prairie under a darkening sky, with long grass bowing in waves before a coming storm. A girl in a gingham dress stands in the doorway holding a little black dog, and a farmer with a long beard looks anxiously at the sky. A classic American picture-book illustration of about 1900, in flat, bold colour.
story-oz-cyclone-2: A small wooden farmhouse spins high in the air at the centre of a great whirling grey cyclone, carried far above the prairie. Through a window a girl and a little black dog can just be seen. A classic American picture-book illustration of about 1900, in flat, bold colour.
story-happyprince-swallow: Moonlight over the rooftops of an old northern European city: a tall gilded statue of a young prince stands on a high column, with sapphire eyes, a red ruby on his sword-hilt and tears running down his golden cheeks. A little swallow perches between his feet, looking up at him. A tender classic fairy-tale illustration in watercolour and gold.
story-happyprince-swallow-2: Through an open window of a poor little house at night, a thin seamstress sits sewing passion-flowers on a satin gown by candlelight, while her small son lies ill in a bed in the corner. A swallow is seen at the window sill. A tender classic fairy-tale illustration in muted watercolour.
story-lamb-tempest: A wild storm at sea off a rocky, enchanted island: a fine large sailing ship of the Renaissance tosses on huge waves, while on the shore an old man in a long magician's robe with a staff and a book stands beside his young daughter, who holds out her hands in pity towards the ship. Faint airy spirits swirl in the clouds. A classic Victorian Shakespeare storybook illustration.
story-lamb-tempest-2: Inside a rocky cave on the island, lit by a warm lamp: the old man in the magician's robe sits with his daughter, telling her the story of her early childhood, with his books of magic piled about them. A classic Victorian Shakespeare storybook illustration.
story-naidu-palanquin: Four bearers in white dhotis and turbans carry a richly decorated, curtained palanquin along a riverside path in India at dawn, stepping in rhythm, while the silken curtains sway. Lotus flowers in the water and a pale golden sky. Painted in the soft, graceful manner of an early twentieth-century Indian miniature-inspired illustration.
story-holmes-observe: A cosy, cluttered sitting-room in a late Victorian city, firelit on a rainy evening: a tall, thin man with a sharp face sits forward in an armchair, studying the shoe of a moustached friend in a frock coat who stands by the fire. Books, a violin case and chemistry bottles about the room. A classic late-Victorian magazine illustration in pen and wash.
story-holmes-observe-2: A narrow staircase in a Victorian town house, seen from the bottom, with a tall thin man pointing up the steps while his moustached friend looks up, puzzled. Gaslight on the walls. A classic late-Victorian magazine illustration in pen and wash.
story-carol-scrooge: A narrow, foggy street in an early Victorian city in winter: a thin, stooped old man in a black coat and tall hat walks alone, pinched and frosty-browed, while passers-by and even a little dog step aside into doorways to avoid him. Snow on the cobbles and dim lamplight. A classic Victorian book illustration in ink and muted watercolour.
story-carol-scrooge-2: A cold, gloomy counting-house office in a Victorian city on Christmas Eve: a stooped old man at a high desk counting coins by a single candle, with a tiny dying fire in the grate. A classic Victorian book illustration in ink and muted watercolour.
story-blake-tiger: A magnificent tiger with burning orange-and-black stripes pads through a dark, deep forest at night, its eyes glowing, with stars glinting through the tangled branches above. Painted in the glowing, hand-coloured style of an illuminated poetry book of the 1790s, with curling vines at the edges and no words.
story-gitanjali-35: Dawn breaking over a wide Indian landscape of a century ago: a clear stream winds out of a dry, sandy plain towards green fields and open village courtyards with no walls between them, and people stand with heads held high in the first light. Soft, luminous colours in the manner of early twentieth-century Indian wash painting.
story-sonnet-18: An English summer meadow of Shakespeare's time in golden light, with darling buds of May on a hawthorn hedge and a breeze shaking the blossoms, while a figure in Elizabethan dress sits under a tree writing on a sheet of paper with a quill. Soft, glowing painting in the style of an Elizabethan miniature, with no visible writing.
story-midsummer-puck: A moonlit wood near an ancient Greek city: a tiny fairy with gossamer wings, carrying a dewdrop like a pearl, meets a mischievous impish sprite with pointed ears perched on a mossy branch among cowslips and ferns. Glow-worms light the dark. A magical classic Victorian Shakespeare illustration in deep blues and silver.
story-midsummer-epilogue: A theatre stage of Shakespeare's time at the end of a play, lit by candles: an impish sprite with pointed ears and a wreath of leaves steps to the front of the stage and bows, holding out his hands to the audience, while shadowy fairies fade into a painted moonlit wood behind him. A classic Victorian Shakespeare illustration.
story-bacon-studies: A scholar's panelled study of about 1600, with tall leaded windows, an oak table heaped with leather-bound books, an hourglass and a quill pen. An older gentleman in a ruff and dark robe reads by the window, one book open, others stacked to be tasted later. Rich, quiet colours in the style of a Jacobean portrait painting, with no visible writing.
story-kipling-if: A father and his teenage son of about 1910 walk together along a windy cliff path above the sea, the father with a hand on the boy's shoulder, pointing to the far horizon where the sun breaks through storm clouds. A classic Edwardian book illustration in warm watercolour.
story-pride-opening: A comfortable Regency drawing-room of an English country house, about 1810: an excited mother in a lace cap and high-waisted gown talks eagerly to her husband, who sits calmly behind a book in an armchair with a dry little smile. Tall windows onto a green park. An elegant Regency-era illustration in delicate pen and watercolour.
story-pride-opening-2: The same Regency drawing-room: the mother, still talking with her hands, while her husband peers over his book at her with patient amusement, and through the window a grand house can be seen on a distant hill. An elegant Regency-era illustration in delicate pen and watercolour.
story-gettysburg-address: A grey November afternoon in 1863 on rolling American farmland: a large, quiet crowd in coats and bonnets gathers on a hillside before a simple wooden platform, beneath bare trees and flags, at the dedication of a new cemetery. A tall, thin figure in a black coat stands to speak, seen from a respectful distance. A sober, dignified nineteenth-century engraving style with soft colour, no faces in detail.
story-douglass-bread: A busy brick street near a shipyard in a harbour town of the 1820s: a young Black boy of about twelve, holding a small book, kneels with a group of thin, hungry boys of the street, sharing pieces of bread while one of them points to a page. Ships' masts rise behind the rooftops. A dignified, warm nineteenth-century storybook illustration, respectful and calm.
story-douglass-bread-2: The same boys sit together on the steps of a brick house at dusk, talking earnestly, one boy looking out towards the masts of the ships in the harbour. A dignified, warm nineteenth-century illustration.
story-keats-grasshopper: An English cottage garden at the edge of a hayfield: a green grasshopper rests beneath a broad leaf in hot summer sunshine, new-mown hay and hedgerows behind, while inside the open cottage door a cricket sits on the warm hearth beside a glowing stove. Delicate Regency-era watercolour, soft and drowsy.
story-magi-della: A small, shabby furnished flat in a big American city about 1905: a slender young woman in a plain blouse stands at a window looking sadly out at a grey cat on a grey backyard fence, a few coins counted out on the table beside her. Worn red carpet and a narrow tall mirror between the windows. A classic early twentieth-century magazine illustration in soft colour.
story-magi-della-2: The same shabby flat: the young woman stands before the tall narrow mirror with her beautiful brown hair let down, rippling and shining to below her knees like a waterfall. Lamp light and a worn red carpet. A classic early twentieth-century magazine illustration in soft colour.
story-saki-window: An English country-house drawing-room on an October afternoon about 1910: a nervous young gentleman sits stiffly on the edge of a chair, while a composed girl of fifteen in a white dress stands by a large open French window that looks out on to a lawn and a misty moor beyond. Long autumn shadows. A classic Edwardian magazine illustration, quietly atmospheric.
story-saki-window-2: The open French window at dusk, seen from inside the drawing-room: the lawn beyond fades into a grey twilight moor, and the curtains stir in the breeze. Atmospheric Edwardian illustration in muted greys and gold, gently mysterious and not frightening.
story-mariner-calm: An old wooden sailing ship of the eighteenth century lies perfectly still on a flat, glassy ocean, its sails hanging slack, under a hot copper-coloured sky with a small fierce sun right above the mast. Weary sailors slump on the deck. Atmospheric Romantic-era painting in burnt orange, copper and deep blue.
story-walden-woods: A small wooden cabin of the 1840s at the edge of a clear, still pond in a wood in the north-eastern United States at dawn, mist rising off the water. A man in plain work clothes sits on the doorstep with a notebook on his knee, watching the sun come up through the pines. A quiet nineteenth-century American landscape painting in soft early light, with no visible writing.
story-walden-woods-2: The same pond and cabin in full morning light, the man walking along the shore among tall pines, looking out across the bright water. A quiet nineteenth-century American landscape painting.
book-alice-1: A girl with long fair hair in a simple blue dress and white pinafore kneels in a long, dim hall lit by hanging lamps, peering through a tiny open door at a sunlit garden of bright flowers and cool fountains, while a little three-legged glass table with a tiny golden key stands behind her. Classic Victorian children's-book illustration in soft watercolour and fine ink line; no lettering, words or numbers anywhere, no signature.
book-alice-2: A girl with long fair hair in a simple blue dress and white pinafore swims in a great pool of her own tears inside a high hall, beside a small grey mouse, while a duck, a dodo and other birds paddle in the water behind them. Classic Victorian children's-book illustration in soft watercolour and fine ink line; no lettering, words or numbers anywhere, no signature.
book-alice-3: On a grassy bank, a solemn dodo presents a thimble to a girl with long fair hair in a simple blue dress and white pinafore, while a ring of dripping birds and small animals, a mouse, a duck, a parrot and a young eagle among them, crowd round to watch. Classic Victorian children's-book illustration in soft watercolour and fine ink line; no lettering, words or numbers anywhere, no signature.
book-alice-4: A girl with long fair hair in a simple blue dress and white pinafore, grown enormous, is squashed inside a tiny cottage room with one arm reaching out of the window and one foot up the chimney, while small animals outside lean a ladder against the roof. Classic Victorian children's-book illustration in soft watercolour and fine ink line; no lettering, words or numbers anywhere, no signature.
book-alice-5: A girl with long fair hair in a simple blue dress and white pinafore, no taller than the grass, stands on tiptoe to peer over the edge of a huge mushroom, where a large blue caterpillar sits with its arms folded, puffing on a long pipe. Classic Victorian children's-book illustration in soft watercolour and fine ink line; no lettering, words or numbers anywhere, no signature.
book-alice-6: In a shady wood, a girl with long fair hair in a simple blue dress and white pinafore looks up at a large striped cat with an enormous grin, sitting on the bough of a tree, its tail already beginning to fade away. Classic Victorian children's-book illustration in soft watercolour and fine ink line; no lettering, words or numbers anywhere, no signature.
book-alice-7: Under a tree, a long table crowded with teacups and teapots: a hatter in a tall top hat and a wild-eyed hare lean their elbows on a sleeping dormouse between them, while a girl with long fair hair in a simple blue dress and white pinafore sits in a big armchair at the end. Classic Victorian children's-book illustration in soft watercolour and fine ink line; no lettering, words or numbers anywhere, no signature.
book-alice-8: On a bumpy croquet lawn, a girl with long fair hair in a simple blue dress and white pinafore tucks a pink flamingo under her arm like a mallet, about to strike a curled-up hedgehog, while flat playing-card soldiers bend over to make the arches; the cards show only simple painted suit shapes, never numbers. Classic Victorian children's-book illustration in soft watercolour and fine ink line; no lettering, words or numbers anywhere, no signature.
book-alice-9: On a rocky ledge by the sea, a sad creature with a turtle's shell and a calf's head and hooves weeps large tears, while a gryphon, half eagle and half lion, lounges beside a girl with long fair hair in a simple blue dress and white pinafore, who sits listening politely. Classic Victorian children's-book illustration in soft watercolour and fine ink line; no lettering, words or numbers anywhere, no signature.
book-alice-10: On a wide sea-shore, a weeping mock turtle and a gryphon dance solemnly round and round a girl with long fair hair in a simple blue dress and white pinafore, waving their front paws to keep time, with gentle waves and a few lobsters in the shallows behind. Classic Victorian children's-book illustration in soft watercolour and fine ink line; no lettering, words or numbers anywhere, no signature.
book-alice-11: A crowded courtroom: a king wearing his crown over a judge's wig sits beside a stern queen, a dish of jam tarts waits on a table, a jury of birds and small animals scribble on slates, and a girl with long fair hair in a simple blue dress and white pinafore watches from the benches. Classic Victorian children's-book illustration in soft watercolour and fine ink line; no lettering, words or numbers anywhere, no signature.
book-alice-12: In a courtroom, a whole pack of playing cards rises into the air and swirls down like falling leaves around a girl with long fair hair in a simple blue dress and white pinafore, now grown to her full size, who throws up her arms to beat them off; the cards show only simple painted suit shapes, never numbers. Classic Victorian children's-book illustration in soft watercolour and fine ink line; no lettering, words or numbers anywhere, no signature.
book-wind-1: Mole, a small velvety black mole in a waistcoat sits in the stern of a little blue-and-white rowing boat on a sparkling summer river, wide-eyed with delight, while Ratty, a brown water rat in a straw boater sculls and a fat wicker luncheon-basket sits at their feet; willows lean over the water. Classic Edwardian children's-book illustration in soft watercolour and fine ink line, the animals in Edwardian clothes; no lettering, words or numbers anywhere, no signature.
book-wind-2: Toad, a stout green toad in a checked country suit sits in the middle of a dusty country road in a happy trance, gazing after a motor-car vanishing in a cloud of dust, while Ratty, a brown water rat in a straw boater shakes his fists and Mole, a small velvety black mole in a waistcoat calms an old grey horse beside a canary-yellow caravan lying wrecked in the ditch. Classic Edwardian children's-book illustration in soft watercolour and fine ink line, the animals in Edwardian clothes; no lettering, words or numbers anywhere, no signature.
book-wind-3: Mole, a small velvety black mole in a waistcoat cowers in the hollow of an old beech tree in a dark, leafless winter wood at dusk, while sly, narrow little animal faces peer from holes among the roots and dead leaves swirl. Classic Edwardian children's-book illustration in soft watercolour and fine ink line, the animals in Edwardian clothes; no lettering, words or numbers anywhere, no signature.
book-wind-4: In a great fire-lit kitchen with a red brick floor, hams hanging from the rafters and plates winking on the dresser, Badger, a big grey badger with a white stripe down his face, in a long dressing-gown welcomes Mole, a small velvety black mole in a waistcoat and Ratty, a brown water rat in a straw boater to a long supper table, snow still on their coats. Classic Edwardian children's-book illustration in soft watercolour and fine ink line, the animals in Edwardian clothes; no lettering, words or numbers anywhere, no signature.
